in_marathi.name: Druthi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Druthi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Druthi is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'Druth' which means desire or longing. It is a name for a girl signifying strong inner desire and determination. This name is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing abundance and prosperity.
